key_idea: Confusion needs two empty slots of different types, so the cheapest way is to empty the two smallest piles.
sketch: Two different fork types must be completely missing from the drawer, so all forks of two types were in the dishwasher. Minimise by picking the two smallest counts and output their sum. Sort or scan for the two minima, O(n log n). Use 64-bit since the sum can reach 2e9.
